What happens to our persistence after about 10 minutes of using AI?
A new paper (Carnegie Mellon, UC Berkeley, Oxford, MIT, UCLA; 1,200+ participants) tested it. When the AI was switched off without warning, people performed worse than those who never had it, and gave up more often.
Cal Newport’s post: https://buff.ly/RnZzBhR
The paper: https://buff.ly/67TU8AA
